newsitem.title: GERMANY: Daimler sees 97 sales of 115 bln DM.
newsitem.headline: Daimler sees 97 sales of 115 bln DM.

text.p: Daimler-Benz AG Chairman Juergen Schrempp on Wednesday repeated a forecast that 1997 sales would rise to around 115 billion marks ($67.5 billion), from 106.34 billion in 1996.
At Daimler's annual news conference in April, Schrempp had forecast that sales this year would growth around 10 percent from the 19965 level.
Schrempp told shareholders earlier on Wednesday that Daimler would report a "substantial" increase in turnover in 1997.
Sales in the first four months of 1997 rose 15 percent to 36.3 billion marks.
Passenger car sales in the period increased 14 percent to 16.2 billion marks and commercial vehicle sales climbed 15 percent to 11.6 billion marks.
